title: Influence bound for a truncated normalized sum
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and $i$ a coordinate in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. On the sign cube $\{−1,1\}^n$, define $g(x)$ by truncating $\sum_{j=0}^{n-1}x_j/\sqrt n$ to the interval $[-1,1]$. The influence of $g$ at $i$, the uniform average of its squared discrete derivative, is at most $1/n$.
